TOOLING BURST FL-1b — fire lane: diagnose two possible G1 regressions after FL-1a, then re-baseline the byte locks with evidence (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-82). task_id "FL-1b". £0 build unless Part A finds a regression.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4r, T4v, FL-1a and the new row "FL-1b — post-FL-1a diagnosis + byte-lock re-baseline" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py (G1 component after FL-1a: halo, release-socket resolution via sprite.to_global, rear separation/body clearance, range fizzle), export/effect_kit.py, runs/C-5/t3/FL-1a/acceptance.json (what FL-1a changed and measured), tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_props_layer.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py, the fixtures those tests reference (read-only), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

CONTEXT: after FL-1a the outside suite (conductor, pytest, 708 pass / 37 red) shows: (a) GroundVisibilityRegressionTests.test_ice_picker_binding_shards_and_ground_crown — `any(event=='contact' for ice_events)` is FALSE (the ice bolt in that synthetic fixture never contacts); (b) FrozenOrbPickerTests.test_headless_orb_clock_and_pool — the orb runtime probe TIMES OUT at 60 s (it completed before FL-1a); (c) FireLaneHeadlessTests.test_literal_halo_drawn_size_at_most_half_bh — the conductor's clause was wrong arithmetic (0.35 BH RADIUS x 1.15 pulse = 0.805 BH diameter); ruling R-C5-81: the halo is accepted as built, realign the clause to diameter <= 0.85 BH; (d) byte-lock / all-text locks now red because FL-1a changed the emitted scene text for every project: IceTreatmentImportTests.test_ten_existing_export_bytes_unchanged, BoltChainEmissionTests.test_current_catalogue_and_original_kits_unchanged, ProjectileArmPickerTests.test_original_eight_export_byte_lock, PieceLap2ExportTests.test_six_kits_and_v1_match_488_file_pre_t4j_hash_table, VfxPickerTests.test_single_kit_and_legacy_props_all_text_byte_identical_to_t3m, and in tests/test_props_layer.py: PropsLayerTests.test_absent_movement_props_byte_identical_to_frozen_t3k_all_text, PropsLayerT3mTests.test_optional_defaults_preserve_legacy_vertices_and_scene_text, PropsLayerT3pTests.test_no_fade_key_byte_identical_to_t3o_all_text, PropsLayerT3rTests.test_t3q_fixture_all_text_byte_identical_and_empty_has_no_script, PropsLayerT3qTests.test_t3p_fixtures_byte_identical_all_text (2 subtests); plus RenderedLookTraceTests.test_seal_bbox_and_whole_loop_ring_radius (T4x; the seal aspect clause is unhonourable per T4x — mark it expectedFailure with the reason, it retires with the Healing Hands re-spec).

PART A — DIAGNOSE FIRST (a) and (b). IN-SCENE EVIDENCE (conductor, PACK v32, runs/C-5/t3/FL1-fire-8dir-v32/): the ICE bolt cast east from (3760,640) now passes THROUGH the shield dummy (~1.3 BH east) and shatters at the dog beyond it; the FIRE bolt east bursts ~0.5–1 BH PAST the shield dummy instead of on it (v31: on it). So this is a RUNTIME regression of contact geometry, not a stale fixture: FL-1a's rear-separation / body-clearance offset most likely moved the collision origin (or the Area2D) away from the head's leading edge. Fix so the contact point is the head's leading tip as before FL-1a, for every G1 kit, and prove it with the east cast trace: fire contact at the shield dummy's collision edge (±0.2 BH), ice likewise; keep all three FL-1a fixes (halo, release side, fizzle) — re-run their clauses. For each: reproduce with the test's own fixture; determine whether the RUNTIME regressed (FL-1a's socket resolution / rear separation / body clearance / halo now prevents contact or never terminates) or the FIXTURE/PROBE is stale (e.g. the synthetic sockets [[270,240]]*4 with release_index 2 now place the release outside the prop's reach after the rear separation; a probe that waits on an event the fizzle path no longer emits). Evidence: the trace (positions per frame, events) and a one-paragraph diagnosis each. If RUNTIME: fix the runtime so contact and termination behave as before FL-1a for every G1 kit, keeping FL-1a's three fixes; re-run FL-1a's three trace clauses to prove nothing regressed. If FIXTURE/PROBE: realign the fixture/probe minimally and say exactly what was stale. NEVER weaken an assertion to pass.

PART B — BYTE LOCKS (d). For each lock: produce a unified diff between the locked fixture text and the current export (or the hash table's file list), summarise the differing lines, and re-baseline ONLY IF every difference is attributable to FL-1a's changes (halo node/material, socket-resolution lines, range-fizzle config) — record the diff summary in acceptance.json per lock. Any other difference = a regression: do not re-baseline; report it. Where a lock is a hash table, regenerate it from the current export and list the changed entries with their reason.

PART C — (c) realign the halo clause to `drawn diameter <= 0.85 BH` (state the arithmetic in the test docstring).

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-1b/acceptance.json): Part A diagnoses with traces; Part B per-lock diff summaries; all 17 kits byte-identical (this burst changes no kit); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; the named tests green in the sandbox, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): extend/realign only the named tests; DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-1b/; fixtures/ ONLY for re-baselined lock texts (list each). Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-1b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
